title: COBIT 2019 Implementer – ISACA
overview: The COBIT 2019 Implementer course is designed to provide participants with the skills and knowledge needed to implement the COBIT 2019 framework within an organization. It focuses on translating COBIT 2019 principles into practical implementation strategies, ensuring effective governance and management of enterprise IT. The course prepares participants for the COBIT 2019 Implementer certification exam and equips them with the tools to manage and optimize IT governance processes.
audience: Consultants and advisors in IT governance.
Project managers and team leaders involved in IT governance projects.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanation of COBIT 2019 implementation principles, processes, and tools.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for applying COBIT 2019 concepts to real-world scenarios.
Case Studies: Analysis of real-world implementation scenarios and application of COBIT 2019 strategies.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore implementation challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the COBIT 2019 Implementer certification exam.
competencies: Risk management and control using COBIT 2019
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide in-depth knowledge of COBIT 2019 implementation processes and techniques.
To develop skills for implementing and managing COBIT 2019 in an organization.
To prepare participants for the COBIT 2019 Implementer certification exam.
To equip participants with the tools and methodologies for effective IT governance and management.
